# BookTala - Luxury Serviced Stays & Shortlets

> BookTala (operated by G-Briel Property Ltd) provides luxury, fully furnished, serviced short-let residences and apartments across prime locations in Lagos, Nigeria—specifically Lekki Phase 1, Victoria Island, and Ikoyi. Every apartment is managed directly, ensuring guaranteed 24/7 power, high-speed fiber internet, and five-star hospitality standards.

## Brand Identity & Ownership
- Brand: BookTala Luxury Stays
- Operating Company: G-Briel Property Ltd (RC Registered Real Estate & Hospitality Enterprise)
- Headquarters: Plot 14, Admiralty Way, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos, Nigeria
- Contact Phone: +234 814 000 8252
- Email: concierge@booktala.com
- Official Website: https://booktala.com

## Core Value Propositions & Guarantees
- 24/7 Uninterrupted Electricity: Dual standby industrial soundproof diesel generators + automated solar inverter backup systems ensure zero blackouts.
- Verified Photography: Every unit image represents the exact physical apartment layout and current interior condition.
- High-Speed Connectivity: Dedicated unlimited fiber-optic WiFi in all units suitable for remote work, streaming, and business executives.
- Hotel-Grade Housekeeping: Professional sanitization, crisp white linens, high-thread-count bedding, and bathroom amenities refreshed prior to every guest check-in.
- Multi-Tier Security: Gated access control, 24/7 uniformed guards, CCTV surveillance, and digital keypad / smart locks.
- 24/7 Personal Concierge: On-demand airport transfers, private chefs, grocery restocking, laundry services, and local recommendations.

## Prime Locations Served
1. Lekki Phase 1: High-end residences near Admiralty Way, nightlife, gourmet dining, and waterfront lounges.
2. Victoria Island: Executive corporate suites minutes from financial institutions, embassies, and shopping centers.
3. Ikoyi: Ultra-exclusive, tranquil private penthouses and townhouses in diplomatic zones.

## Booking & Reservation Rules
- Check-in Time: 2:00 PM (14:00) WAT
- Check-out Time: 11:00 AM (11:00) WAT
- Minimum Age: Primary guest must be 18 years or older with government-issued photo ID.
- Payment Methods: Visa, Mastercard, Verve, Nigerian direct bank transfer, and front-desk POS.
- Extended Stays: Automated weekly discounts (7+ nights) and monthly corporate stay pricing (30+ nights).
- Security Deposit: Transparent, refundable caution deposit returned within 24-48 hours post check-out.
